title: Project Context
subtitle: Markdown docs from this repo that agents and skills can read as grounding context. Read-only: docs are never edited here.
reindexHint: Reload the list of docs from the clone
downloadHint: Download the previewed text (redacted and truncated like the preview)
notCloned: This repository isn’t cloned yet, so there are no docs to list. Import or refresh it first.

empty.title: No docs found
empty.body: No Markdown files were found under {roots}. Add the folders that hold your PRDs, tech specs and acceptance criteria to the Roots panel below.

truncated.title: The list is incomplete
truncated.file_limit: Too many files: only the first ones are shown.
truncated.depth_limit: Some folders are nested too deeply and were skipped.
truncated.time_limit: Scanning took too long and was stopped.

roots.title: Roots
roots.hint: One folder per line, relative to the repo root. Up to 10.
roots.label: Context roots

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Select a doc to preview it.
preview.truncated: Preview truncated to the first part of the file.
preview.editDisabled: Docs are read-only here. Edit them in the repository.

attach.title: Attach to an agent
attach.hint: Attached docs are injected into that agent’s review prompt for this repo.
attach.none: Nothing attached for this repo yet.
attach.limit: At most 10 docs can be attached.

statusHint.ok: The doc is in the clone and under the current roots.
statusHint.missing: The file is no longer in the clone; it will be skipped at review time.
statusHint.outside_roots: The path is not under the current roots; it will be skipped at review time.

usage.label: {count, plural, =0 {Not used by any agent} one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}

footer.tokensHint: Approximate: file size / 4. Review runs read at most 32 KB and 4,000 tokens per doc.

tab.noRepo: Select a repository to attach project context docs.
tab.title: Project context

serializes.title: Serializes as
serializes.empty: No docs attached for this repository, so nothing is added to the prompt.
serializes.skipped: {count, plural, one {# attached doc is} other {# attached docs are}} missing or outside the roots and will be skipped.
serializes.hint: In a review run each doc is wrapped as untrusted content under these headings. Inside a heading the agent's own docs come first, then the docs of its skills.

agentTab.title: Project context
agentTab.helper: Checked docs are attached to this agent. Attached docs are listed first, in the order they are injected.
agentTab.empty: No docs found for this repository.
agentTab.reorderError: Could not save the new order. The list shows the saved order.
agentTab.tokensHint: Approximate prompt size of the attached docs: file size / 4, at most 32 KB and 4,000 tokens per doc. Docs of the agent's skills share the same budget.
agentTab.overBudget: The attached docs are about {tokens} tokens, over the {limit}-token Project context budget. Docs past the budget are skipped in review runs, so reorder or detach some.
agentTab.footer: Attached docs are injected as an untrusted “## Project context” block into review runs of this agent on pull requests of this repository.
